lines: There will be seven more in there.
You have been getting away with talent.
That stops being enough this year.
Learn the craft. Earn your own keep.
Do that and the rest follows.
It was dark and you did it anyway.
That is the part I am talking about.
Five silverling, off the steps below.
The line is magic. So is the patience.
Five, and not a weed among them.
Take them up to the yard.
That is what the post says.
Six, and you carry your own crate.
That is the last of it.
Three fish, three hands, one hearth.
Cold heart, low flame. That is all it is.
They ate. That is the whole of it.
Come back when you can do six.
The gate is yours until the bell.
Two strays usually come up the road.
Turn them back. Do not chase them.
You did not sit down once. Good.
The draw is measured and the draw is even.
So it was written, so it is read.
Whitewall takes what Whitewall is owed.
No more, and never in the dark.
Come up. The font is uncovered.
